english.title: Put or place poison or food or fluid rendered poisonous on land or in building
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly

(A)_[put or placed]_
(B)_[caused or procured another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to put or place]_
(C)_[knowingly was a party to the putting or placing]_

in or upon

(D)_[land at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(E)_[a building, namely **(..SPECIFY BUILDING..),]_

(F)_[poison]_
(G)_[fluid or edible matter, namely **(..SPECIFY FLUID OR EDIBLE MATTER..) which had been rendered poisonous]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(b) of the Protection of Animals Act 1911.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly put or placed, or caused or procured any person to put or place, or knowingly was a party to the putting or placing, in or upon any land or building any poison, or any fluid or edible matter (not being sown seed or grain) which has been rendered poisonous.
